text: Then cytokinesis, the division of the cytoplasm. It usually follows mitosis, and commonly starts while mitosis is finishing. The cytoplasm divides around the two nuclei already formed, giving two daughter cells. Only now does this per-cell graph drop, from two units to one: each daughter cell holds half the doubled DNA, four chromosomes and four DNA molecules in the model, forty-six and forty-six in the human case.
